preconditions.description: The number of distinct integers n is at least 1 and at most 10^5.
The number of points k is at least 0 and at most 10^8.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output is list and len(output) == n and all(1 <= a <= 10^9 for a in output) and len(set(output)) == n)
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a list of n distinct integers each at most 10^9.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or sum(gcd(output[i], output[i+1]) for i in range(n-1)) == k
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, then the sum of gcd of each pair of adjacent numbers in the output is exactly k.
